integrity: The asymptotic proof is analytic and based on the exact radial minimization formula and exact Laguerre coefficients. The bundled numerical checker is corroborative, not evidentiary for the infinite asymptotic claim.
scientific_limitations: Fixed \(n\ge3\) and \(t\to0^+\) only; no uniform large-\(n\) statement, no global entropy optimum, and no classification of all Wigner-positive boundary states.
title: Sharp near-vacuum boundary layer for maximal Wigner-positive Fock coherence
